purpose: Simplify the hero to a product-focused studio image while retaining the user's locked earbud design.

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: simple desktop website hero photograph, landscape 2:1, 1768 x 890.
Input image is the authoritative locked CYMBA earbud design. Re-photograph ONLY the two earbuds from it in a plain studio, preserving their physical design exactly. Exclude the controller and USB connector from the framing.

A straightforward, believable close-up product photograph: two earbuds resting naturally on a seamless matte dark charcoal tabletop that flows into the same plain dark background. One large earbud at left shows its outward matte black oval faceplate, the other at right is turned inward to show the contact/sensor panel. Slightly stagger their positions and angles, as a photographer would arrange the pair. Keep the image quiet and minimal. No props, rock, podium, pedestal, sphere, scenery or background texture.

Scale/framing: the actual earbud bodies together occupy about 52% of the frame width and 42% of frame height. The pair is centered horizontally in the upper-middle: left bud centered around x38%,y40%; right bud around x63%,y37%. Top of fins around y18–22%; lowest parts of housings around y58–61%. Their small cables curve downward unobtrusively, then leave the product area before y67%. No large looping cables crossing the image. The earbuds, not accessories or environment, are unmistakably the subject. Keep the top 14% quiet for a navigation bar and bottom 30% uniformly near-black and empty for live website type. Retain clear space around all edges of the earbuds.

Locked design requirements: smoked translucent charcoal resin shells with subtle internal details; gently domed, finely textured MATTE black oval outer faceplates with a very thin champagne edge; plain curved soft BLACK textured silicone fins with NO contacts or gold elements on the fins. On the right earbud's inner body, two vertically arranged oval champagne contacts sit alongside a small rounded rectangular green optical window in a black panel, exactly as the reference. Smoke-grey silicone ear tips and the reference's two slim champagne insets on the inward-facing tip. Short tapered strain reliefs underneath the shells lead to thin black braided cable. No controller or USB plug in this composition. No design substitutions.

Lighting and finish: one very large soft neutral white light from upper left and gentle fill, a faint soft contact shadow under each earbud, neutral color balance. Moderate contrast, enough light to show the shapes without bright edge halos. Natural subdued champagne, never orange/gold glow. Physically credible silicone, resin and matte surfaces, no wet gloss, excessive reflections, surreal sharpening, swirling microtexture, dramatic backlighting, fog, bloom or spotlight. Realistic catalog photography taken with an 85mm lens, not cinematic CGI. Plain dark charcoal background blends toward black in lower third. No text, branding, labels, diagrams, arrows, UI, watermark or extra objects.
